question:
State all of 3-D Man's attributes along with their values.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: 3-D Man is the superhero_name. attributes refers to attribute_name; values refers to attribute_value;

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT
    a.XCL_004 AS attribute_name,
    a.XCL_004 AS attribute_value
FROM
    superhero s
JOIN
    hero_attribute ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
JOIN
    attribute a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
WHERE
    s.XCL_019 = '3-D Man'
